title: High-Probability Convergence of Clipped SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise and $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2505.20817v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gradient clipping is widely used in language-model training to control heavy-tailed gradient noise and can improve convergence guarantees over stochastic gradient descent (SGD) under $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness. Under these joint conditions, a central challenge is to obtain high-probability guarantees without exponential dependence on $L_1R_0$, where $R_0$ bounds the initial distance to a minimizer. We resolve this challenge for convex objectives, establishing, to the best of our knowledge, the first such guarantees for standard Clip-SGD. We assume unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded central $\alpha$-th moment, $\alpha\in(1,2]$. Our bounds have only polylogarithmic dependence on the inverse failure probability and recover known deterministic generalized-smoothness rates when the noise vanishes, as well as the standard high-probability rate under heavy-tailed noise in the classical $L$-smooth setting. translated_title: 重尾噪声与 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下裁剪SGD的高概率收敛性
translated_abstract: 梯度裁剪被广泛应用于语言模型训练中以控制重尾梯度噪声，并且在 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下能够比随机梯度下降（SGD）提供更好的收敛保证。在这些联合条件下，一个核心挑战是获得高概率保证且避免对 $L_1R_0$ 的指数级依赖，其中 $R_0$ 限定了初始点到极小值点的距离。我们针对凸目标函数解决了这一挑战，据我们所知，首次为标准Clip-SGD建立了此类保证。我们假设无偏随机梯度具有有界的中心 $\alpha$ 阶矩，其中 $\alpha\in(1,2]$。我们的界对失败概率的倒数仅有多对数级依赖，并且在噪声消失时能够恢复已知的确定性广义平滑速率，在经典 $L$-平滑设置下的重尾噪声情形中也能恢复标准的高概率速率。该凸速率是可以达到的。
tldr: 该论文首次为标准Clip-SGD在重尾噪声和 $(L_0,L_1)$-平滑条件下的凸优化中建立了高概率收敛保证，避免了对 $L_1R_0$ 的指数级依赖，其界对失败概率仅有多对数级依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first high-probability convergence guarantees for standard Clip-SGD under heavy-tailed noise and $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness for convex objectives, avoiding exponential dependence on $L_1R_0$ with only polylogarithmic dependence on the inverse failure probability.
